caption: A ball is rolled up a gentle grassy slope; it slows, stops, and rolls back down.

sa.check: A ball is rolled up a grassy slope.
The slope is gentle rather than steep.
The roll up comes first, then the stop, then the roll back.

pc.expect: On the way up the ball slows, pauses for an instant, then comes back down, quicker the further it rolls.
pc.fail: The ball keeps its speed all the way up the slope; or it stays put where it stopped; or it slows on the way down.

pc.expect: It comes back along roughly the line it went up.
pc.fail: The ball turns sideways on the open slope with nothing touching it; or it rolls back down a part of the slope far from its track up; or it reverses again and rolls uphill.

pc.expect: Nothing touches the ball after the roll; its motion changes only with the slope.
pc.fail: The ball speeds up while going uphill; or it stops and starts more than once on the slope; or it sets off again after coming to rest at the bottom.

pc.expect: The ball stays round and rolls on the grass, which flattens under it.
pc.fail: The ball squashes flat and stays flat; or it slides without turning; or the grass ripples like water as the ball passes.

pc.expect: One ball is on the slope throughout and stays above the ground.
pc.fail: The ball vanishes or a second one appears; or it passes through the ground; or it turns into another object.

pc.expect: The ball's colour, the slope and the background stay the same.
pc.fail: The ball changes colour; or the slope changes gradient between frames; or the background rearranges.
